law.title: General Local Law 2018 (No. 1)
law.madeUnder: s.111 Local Government Act 1989 and s.42 Domestic Animals Act 1994

phases.name: Initiate & diagnose
phases.detail: Project plan, governance, clause-by-clause internal review, triage of the held-over backlog.

phases.name: Evidence & benchmarking
phases.detail: Enforcement and request data, permit volumes, VCAT and complaint history, comparison against neighbouring councils' current laws.

phases.name: Community & stakeholder engagement
phases.detail: Issues-stage engagement under the Community Engagement Policy — before positions are fixed.

phases.name: Pilots & operational testing
phases.detail: Test proposed changes operationally under existing powers, permit conditions or policy, so the drafting rests on evidence.

phases.name: Policy settlement
phases.detail: Councillor briefings, position papers, resolution of contested items.

phases.name: Drafting & statutory assessments
phases.detail: Drafting instructions, legal drafting, Community Impact Statement, Human Rights Charter assessment, competition assessment.

phases.name: Statutory exhibition & submissions
phases.detail: Public notice, exhibition of the proposed local law, receipt and hearing of submissions.

phases.name: Making, gazettal & commencement
phases.detail: Council resolution to make the law, publication in the Government Gazette, public notice, commencement.

phases.name: Transition & implementation
phases.detail: Delegations and authorisations, officer training, permit migration, signage, incorporated document updates, communications.

gates.title: Project plan, governance and resourcing endorsed
gates.test: Sponsor, steering group, budget and a named drafting resource are all confirmed in writing.

gates.title: Review commenced — scope and engagement plan endorsed
gates.test: Council resolves to commence the review and endorses the engagement approach under the Community Engagement Policy.
gates.authority: Local Government Act 2020 s.55 (community engagement policy)

gates.title: Clause triage complete, backlog dispositioned
gates.test: Every clause in the register carries a disposition and an owner; every backlog item is in scope, out of scope or deferred with a reason.

gates.title: Consultation findings and pilot evidence accepted
gates.test: Engagement report published back to participants; each pilot has a written evaluation against its stated measure.

gates.title: Policy positions confirmed
gates.test: Councillors have seen an options paper on every contested item and indicated a preferred position.

gates.title: Drafting instructions and Community Impact Statement approved
gates.test: Instructions signed off; Community Impact Statement covers restriction of competition and administrative burden.
gates.authority: Victorian local law guidelines — community impact statement

gates.title: Draft law and statutory assessments complete
gates.test: Draft law, Charter of Human Rights compatibility assessment and competition assessment are complete and legally reviewed.
gates.authority: Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act 2006

gates.title: Resolve to give notice of the proposed local law
gates.test: Council resolves to give public notice; notice states purpose and general purport and where a copy may be obtained.
gates.authority: Local Government Act 2020 Part 3 Div. 2 — process for making a local law

gates.title: Submissions considered and submitters heard
gates.test: All submissions tabled, submitters who asked to be heard have been heard, and a response to each theme is documented.
gates.authority: Council's Community Engagement Policy and Governance Rules

gates.title: Resolve to make the local law
gates.test: Council resolves to make the local law in its final form. This is the immovable decision — everything downstream is administrative.

gates.title: Published in the Government Gazette, public notice given, copy to the Minister
gates.test: Gazette notice published, public notice given, and a copy provided to the Minister within the statutory period.
gates.authority: Local Government Act 2020 Part 3 Div. 2 — publication requirements

gates.title: New law commences — 30 days clear of the sunset
gates.test: New law in operation, delegations and authorisations remade, officers trained, permits migrated, website and signage updated.

boundaries.label: Sunset — General Local Law 2018 (No. 1) ceases to operate
boundaries.note: Clause 4 of the current law. A ten-year life from commencement on 20 July 2018. There is no power to extend it: if nothing replaces it, every permit trigger, notice power and infringeable offence in the register stops on this date.

boundaries.label: Indicative start of the election caretaker period
boundaries.note: Victorian council general elections fall in October 2028. Major decisions are constrained once the election period starts, so there is no usable float past August 2028. Confirm the exact date with Governance when the Victorian Electoral Commission publishes it.
